source.title: Ulster Herald, 23 April 1927, p. 5 ("Omagh Rural Council / Clogher Rural Council nominations")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: nominations read on the block images of the Ulster Herald's 'Omagh Rural Council' (23 April 1927, p. 5, article ULH19270423.2.79); contests were threatened only in Fallagh, Fintona and Seskinore, and Seskinore was the only division polled; one nomination in each division below

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Seskinore was the only contest in the district; all other divisions were filled unopposed and are not printed in the reports traced. The Belfast Telegraph of 2 June 1927, p. 11, prints this division as 'Eskmore' and gives the result as W. J. Clelland (U.) 163, W. J. Clyde (Ratepayers' Association) 96, with three spoiled votes; the candidate names recorded here come from the other reports and differ from the Telegraph's. Filed on 1927-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1927-06-02 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Thirty-one unopposed returns are added from the Ulster Herald's nomination list (23 April 1927, p. 5). Fallagh and Fintona had two nominations each and were not polled; the withdrawals were not found, so they are not recorded; Lifford and Moorfield are not in the printed list (6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
